eye_proxy_stop_line.eye_proxy_scope: M335 spatial focus_cx[2,5], not temporal mid-flight

a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_holes_corridor_scope: focus_cx[-6,6] around M335 start locus, not route midpoint
a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_hole_probe_result_semantics: result from an invoked HasMissingGreedyMeshInHorizontalRadius query; it can hit a same-frame shared memo, so invocation does not guarantee an uncached world scan
a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_hole_probe_witness_state_scop: immediate state snapshot for the exact raw radius-query coordinate; owner status covers reported dirty, build, GPU, SoftDefer, publication-debt, and flow-ticket fields only
a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_hole_probe_witness_fog_scope_: classify raw miss witness using the nearest possible horizontal distance from anywhere in the focus chunk to the witness chunk AABB; beyond_fog proves the chunk lies outside the configured fog horizon, while intersects_fog is only a visibility candidate
a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_tracked_witness_event_scope: one exact radius-query witness followed across frames; fog is the configured distance horizon, not camera-frustum or pixel proof
a24_safety_stop_line.near_focus_holes_period_semantics: one terminal frame sample per interval; transient rising edges are reported separately below
a24_safety_stop_line.visual_holes_enter_events_scope: all frame-aligned rising edges (no moving event rows)
a24_safety_stop_line.visual_holes_enter_events_semantics: mesh-coverage proxy events, not framebuffer evidence
a24_safety_stop_line.visual_holes_enter_screen_ray_selection_: selection-time mesh/debt sample from the chosen screen-ray candidate; focus_proxy fields are sampled later in the same streaming refresh, joined by the exact miss coordinates
